provenance.codeRevisions: SCRIPTED FIXTURES from templates/integration/demo/notify-hub (initial, repair-bad, repair-good). Not LLM-authored. LLM build agents use the same tool API.
provenance.liveOperations: REAL: Modal sandboxes (network-blocked, uid-separated) for every repo/validation step; Manufact Cloud API (org Askshepherd org-84350150-jpcs9) for create/update/rollback/republish; MCP over HTTPS to the deployed child with parent-minted EdDSA tokens.
provenance.childSigningKey: Ephemeral Ed25519 key generated for the demo process and never persisted. The demo child (server a12cbbe4-f43f-4fcf-9e48-7dda8238047e, https://fast-spark-ycqax.run.mcp-use.com/mcp) now rejects every token: it fails closed. Production uses the persistent host key from the main env.
provenance.simulatedUpstream: The deployed child uses its in-process simulated Notify Hub API (NOTIFY_HUB_SIMULATED=1). No real third-party side effects.
provenance.sanitization: Removed host credentials and any JWT/private-key/API-token patterns (0 redaction(s)). Receipts list env var NAMES only.
